---
- hosts: all
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: set hostname
      hostname:
        name: "{{ inventory_hostname }}"

    - name: set hosts
      include_role:
        name: lukeyeager.hosts
      vars:
        hosts_add_default_ipv4: false
        hosts_add_ansible_managed_hosts: true

    - name: install software packages
      include_role:
        name: software_packages

    - name: set system envvars
      include_role:
        name: system_envvars

    - name: mount tmpfs
      mount:
        path: "{{ item.path }}"
        src: tmpfs
        fstype: tmpfs
        state: mounted
        opts: rw,nosuid,nodev,relatime,mode={{ item.mode | default('755') }},uid={{ item.user | default('root') }},gid={{ item.group | default('root') }}
      with_items: "{{ bootstrap_tmpfs }}"

    - name: create directories
      file:
        path: "{{ item.path }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ item.user | default('root') }}"
        group: "{{ item.group | default('root') }}"
        mode: "{{ item.mode | default('755') }}"
      with_items: "{{ bootstrap_dirs }}"

---
- hosts: all

  vars_files:
    - ../vars/nvidia.yml

  tasks:
    - name: install custom facts module
      include_role:
        name: facts
        apply:
          tags:
            - always
      tags:
        - always

    - block:
      - name: install driver
        include_role:
          name: nvidia.nvidia_driver
          apply:
            tags:
              - nvidia_driver
        tags:
          - always

      - name: start persistenced
        service:
          name: nvidia-persistenced
          enabled: yes
          state: started
          daemon_reload: true

      - name: create UVM service
        blockinfile:
          path: /etc/systemd/system/nvidia-uvm.service
          create: yes
          block: |
            [Unit]
            Description=Load Nvidia UVM module
            After=nvidia-persistenced.service

            [Service]
            Type=oneshot
            ExecStart=/usr/bin/nvidia-modprobe -u -c=0

            [Install]
            WantedBy=multi-user.target

      - name: start UVM
        service:
          name: nvidia-uvm
          enabled: yes
          state: started
          daemon_reload: true

      - name: install fabric manager
        include_role:
          name: nvidia-fabric-manager
        when: ansible_local.nvlinks.count

      - name: install gdrcopy
        include_role:
          name: nvidia-gdrcopy

      - name: register nvidia peermem
        blockinfile:
          path: /etc/modules-load.d/nvidia-peermem.conf
          create: yes
          block: |
            nvidia-peermem
        when: ansible_local.hcas.count or ansible_local.efas.count

      - name: reload kernel modules
        service:
          name: systemd-modules-load
          state: restarted

      when: ansible_local.gpus.count

# NEPHELE

## Prerequisites

### Install enroot
```bash
sudo apt update -y
arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture)
echo $arch

curl -fSsL -O https://github.com/NVIDIA/enroot/releases/download/v3.4.1/enroot_3.4.1-1_${arch}.deb
curl -fSsL -O https://github.com/NVIDIA/enroot/releases/download/v3.4.1/enroot+caps_3.4.1-1_${arch}.deb
sudo apt install -y ./*.deb
rm enroot*
```

### Install terraform and ansible
```bash
curl -fsSL https://apt.releases.hashicorp.com/gpg | sudo apt-key add -
sudo apt-add-repository "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture)] https://apt.releases.hashicorp.com $(lsb_release -cs) main"
sudo apt update
sudo apt install -y build-essential terraform ansible
```

### Check installation
```bash
terraform --version
ansible --version
```

### If using Azure, additionally install the Azure CLI
https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/cli/azure/install-azure-cli
```bash
curl -sL https://aka.ms/InstallAzureCLIDeb | sudo bash
az login
```


## Setup

### Cloning the repo
Remember to include the recursive flag for submodules.
```bash
git clone --recursive https://github.com/NVIDIA/nephele.git
```

### Edit cluster configuration
```bash
vi nephele.conf
```

### One time setup
```bash
export CONTAINERIZED_BUILD=1
./nephele init
```

### Create the cluster
```bash
./nephele create
```

### Connect to the cluster
Headnode:
```bash
./nephele connect
```

Specific compute node - e.g. x8a100-0000
```
./nephele connect x8a100-0000
```

### Destroy the cluster
```bash
./nephele destroy
```

---
- name: install ubuntu packages
  apt:
    name: nfs-common
    state: latest
  when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"
  tags:
    - nfs

- name: install rhel packages
  yum:
    name: nfs-utils
    state: latest
  when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"
  tags:
    - nfs

- name: configure idmapd domain for nfsv4
  lineinfile:
    dest: /etc/idmapd.conf
    regexp: "^Domain"
    insertafter: "^# Domain"
    line: "Domain = {{ nfs_idmapd_domain }}"
    backup: yes
  when: nfs_idmapd_domain is defined
  tags:
    - nfs

- include: server.yml
  when: nfs_is_server

- include: client.yml
  when: nfs_is_client

---
- name: restart nfs
  service: name=nfs-kernel-server state=restarted
  when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

- name: restart nfs
  service: name=nfs-server state=restarted
  when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

nfs_idmapd_domain: localdomain

nfs_is_server: no
nfs_is_client: no

nfs_exports: []
nfs_mounts: []

---
- name: ensure mountpoint exists
  file:
    path: '{{ item.mountpoint }}'
    state: directory
  with_items: '{{ nfs_mounts }}'
  when: nfs_mounts|length
  tags:
    - nfs

- name: configure /etc/fstab on clients
  mount:
    name: "{{ item.mountpoint}}"
    src: "{{ item.server|default(groups['nfs_server'][0]) }}:{{ item.path }}"
    opts: "{{ item.options }}"
    fstype: nfs
    state: mounted
  with_items: '{{ nfs_mounts }}'
  when: nfs_mounts|length
  tags:
    - nfs
